manifest.notes: Meta-Lane PR5 (Hans-Go 2026-10-25 PR1-PR6, PR7 NOT included). Synergy packages for Chulane, Teller of Tales from the 2026-10-25 drafts. Packages were held back from the PR3 refresh snapshot until PR5 wired them as a scoring input; this file adds them without touching the immutable refresh snapshot. All packages are SUGGESTIONS (strength UNKNOWN, popularity is not strength). No package is a ban or avoidance list. No cEDH data: Chulane has no cedh_tournament band by finding (no tournament presence), and none is invented here.

packages.description: Tier A (EDHREC). Core of the target deck, already present. Expansion candidates Whitemane Lion, Dream Stalker, Man-o'-War are NOT part of this package.
packages.name: Bounce engine

packages.description: Tier A (EDHREC). Core of the target deck, already present. Expansion cards Aesi, Tyrant of Gyre Strait, Avenger of Zendikar, Scute Swarm, Seedborn Muse, Lotus Cobra are NOT part of this package.
packages.name: Landfall / lands-matter

packages.description: Tier A (EDHREC expansion cards) + target deck. Core only: Cloudblazer and Koma, Cosmos Serpent. Expansion cards Beast Whisperer, Coiling Oracle, Mulldrifter, Eternal Witness, Guardian Project, Dour Port-Mage are NOT part of this package.
packages.name: ETB draw / value

packages.description: Tier A as lists (EDHREC/Spellbook). Combo-finisher intent only, NOT in the target deck (only Shrieking Drake is present). Alternatives encoded as one list: Drake OR Whitemane Lion as the bounce creature, Laboratory Maniac OR Thassa's Oracle as the outlet. Adopting it would turn the value plan into a combo plan (owner decision).
packages.name: Aluren loop

packages.description: Combo-engine, NOT in the target deck (only Shrieking Drake is present). Alternatives encoded as one list (Drake, Lion or Stonecloaker as the bounce creature). Requires mana dorks, which are NOT encoded as package cards. Intruder Alarm untaps all creatures on every ETB, opponents' included (play-feel caveat, not a measurement).
packages.name: Intruder Alarm loop

packages.description: Tier A (EDHREC). Fair finisher axis largely missing from the target deck (existing top-end Koma, Cosmos Serpent, Rampaging Baloths are context, not package cards). Addresses the CoolStuff guide's 'spinning wheels' gap description; no strength measurement.
packages.name: Combat finisher

packages.description: Tier A (EDHREC expansion cards) + target deck. Core only: the five cards already in the target deck. Expansion cards Path to Exile, Counterspell, Cyclonic Rift, Beast Within, Heroic Intervention, Dovin's Veto, Eladamri's Call, Worldly Tutor are NOT part of this package.
packages.name: Protection / interaction

packages.description: Tier A (EDHREC). Thin 1-mana ramp actually in the target deck. Expansion dorks (Birds of Paradise, Noble Hierarch, Bloom Tender, Faeburrow Elder, Avacyn's Pilgrim, Delighted Halfling, Elvish Mystic, Fyndhorn Elves, Paradise Druid) are NOT part of this package; the Priest of Titania / Quirion Ranger / Wirewood Symbiote combo deepening belongs with P4/P5, not here.
packages.name: Elf / dork ramp
